title: Book Two · Chapter 106: Twenty Covers
story:
On Monday, the table holds twenty copies of the route picture. Mei checks one copy. Her thin line near the stairs is faint, so she makes it darker.

“The others need this, too,” she says.

Jun takes ten sheets. Ronan takes the rest. They work from the original picture. Soon the stairs show clearly on every page.

The copies cost a small amount from the school activity money. Miss Wu counts them before she leaves for a lesson.

“Keep two here,” she says. “The other eighteen can go to new pupils.”

Ronan puts the two desk copies under a book. Jun ties the others in a small pile.

“Shall we check the room now?” Jun asks.

“The route?”

“The times, too. We can put a copy on the door.”

Ronan sees the passage through the window. A new white notice is on the board at the end. He has seen it twice today. Both times, he turned toward his own classroom instead.

“The teacher already checked,” he says.

“I know. I mean we can give her one.”

“She is busy.”

Jun holds out a copy. “Then leave it for her.”

Ronan takes it. He walks into the passage while Jun sorts the remaining guides.

The notice is beside the materials room. THIS TERM is at the top. Ronan stops. He reads those two words, but he does not read the opening day.

A group of pupils comes around the corner. One of them points to the guide in his hand.

“Are those ready?”

“Yes.”

“Can we have one?”

Ronan gives him the copy. The boy opens it at once and shows it to his friend. Their heads hide the white notice.

Ronan returns to the classroom empty-handed.

“Did you give it to her?” Jun asks.

“No. A new pupil needed it.”

Jun counts the pile again. “Seventeen to give out, then. The two here make nineteen.”

“One is out already.”

“Yes. Twenty altogether.”

Ronan likes the sound of that. Twenty guides. Their work is real now.

After lunch, they stand near the gate. New pupils take the thin guides and put them in bags. Jun tells each one to keep the picture flat.

The small boy with the empty bag comes last.

“Wednesday?” he asks.

“Wednesday,” Ronan says.

Jun writes the boy's first name in his own notebook. Ronan does not ask it. He watches the boy leave with the guide, then reaches into the pile.

There are only three copies left. He smooths their corners. The words on the back are dark and easy to read.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

notice＝通知；this term＝本学期；altogether＝总共；faint＝模糊不清的。

## 理解问题

1. 哪里有本学期的新通知？
2. Ronan有没有去读新通知？

## 读句子

**Jun / counts the pile / again.** Jun／再次清点／那叠纸。
